notes: Fix: captions missing for the first seconds of a clip (seen with Hinglish on clips cut mid-sentence; English uses the same safety net). Missing starts are now found, refilled from a second decoding pass and, if needed, by decoding the first seconds again.
New: download your captions as an .srt subtitle file (section 10): one cue per caption, or a word-by-word build-up. It shows the cue count and the first cues before you download.
Unfillable gaps at the very start are now marked red on the timeline from 0.6 s (before: 1.5 s), so you can listen and add the words.
